# P37.37 — Claim viewer v2 and real capture diff

**Row:** 461 of 510 · `r11/P37.37-claim-viewer-v2` off `r11/P37.36-raw-archive`
**Contract:** `docs/tickets/461_P37.37__claim-viewer-v2-and-capture-diff.md`
**Requirement stamps:** **SIG-EVUI-009** (owned — spec §56 `Owner:`); SIG-EVUI-004 (cited — amends SIG-UI-028); SIG-UI-028, SIG-UI-029 (spec amended via `spec_src` + `BUILD.sh`)
**ADR:** ADR-246 (owned decisions) · Appendix F row landed in the same change (SIG-ENG-039)

## What lands

- **Claim-view generation (`exports/claim_views.py`, `spine_export._evidence`):**
  new `claim_view_bindings` export query — every publishable claim bound to a
  REAL capture (`binding_status='actual_capture'` on
  `capture_classification='actual'`) under the shared claim/artifact/seal
  gates and effective rights — plus the recorded locator, excerpt, claim
  fields, capture metadata and redaction identity. `evidence.json` now emits
  `claim_views`: one per **document-genre** claim with an `actual_capture`
  binding, deterministically capped at **20,000 per release** (D-K8-2
  [B-22]); `build.claim_views` carries `cap`/`eligible`/`emitted`/`overflow`
  and `/evidence/` states the cap and overflow verbatim (SIG-EVUI-009).
- **The lane-aware pane union (SIG-EVUI-004, amends SIG-UI-028):** a fifth
  pane kind `download` — raw-ok captures whose bytes the raw archive serves
  (P37.36's `served_href_map` byte seam) render locator + hash/time + the
  view-original link; `text_span` fires only where the declared
  `capture_texts` seam supplies stored text AND the recorded locator
  resolves; `locator_only`/`metadata_only` carry the typed states lanes that
  forbid bytes. `assertClaimView` checks pane × lane: `download` requires
  the raw-ok lane AND the served href; a label never implies a route the
  release does not carry.
- **D-K8-1 [B-44] excerpt gate (fail closed):** a locator always
  (`Locator.span` is optional — a page/row/selector locator carries none,
  never a fabricated range). The recorded `claim_evidence.excerpt` publishes
  only on a non-metadata pane, ≤300 chars, where the source's recorded terms
  permit quotation — the new `[redistribution].quotation_permitted` marker
  (additive; no source sets it today) — or on raw-ok.
- **The real capture diff (SIG-EVUI-005, amends SIG-UI-029):** per-capture
  `fields` emit recorded predicate → verbatim `raw_value` pairs over every
  publishable bound claim — never fixture bytes; the artifact page states a
  **typed absence** when a second capture isn't recorded ("Only one
  capture…" / "…carry extracted fields").

## Decisions implemented verbatim (GATE-P; no pause)

`D-K8-1 [B-44] / D-K8-2 [B-22] = as recommended` — a locator always; an
excerpt ≤ 300 characters only where recorded terms permit quotation; cap
20k per release; overflow count disclosed.
